question.text: Under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012, the Compliance Test Report (CTR) referenced in Ch 12 is required to be filed by the Investment Manager:

answer.text: At the end of every financial year, certifying compliance with SEBI (AIF) Regulations and circulars issued thereunder.
Every quarter, along with the quarterly NAV report.
Only at the time of PPM registration and no further filings.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that SEBI has prescribed a Compliance Test Report to be filed by the investment manager at the end of every financial year, furnishing details of compliance with AIF Regulations and circulars. For Category III AIFs, the workbook adds that the CTR must be submitted to the Sponsor/Trustee within 30 days. The Trap: Quarterly, one-off and monthly cadences do not match the financial-year filing prescribed for the CTR. Note: Based on Series-XIX-C workbook pp.301, 336 and 430, which set out the annual CTR filing and the 30-day Sponsor/Trustee submission for Category III AIFs.
